title: Bristoe Station Battlefield Heritage Park Guided Tours
name: Bristoe Station Battlefield Heritage Park Guided Tours
description:
Bristoe Station Battlefield Heritage Park staff and volunteers will provide guided tours of this hallowed ground that contains camps, cemeteries, and battlefields. Learn about Camp Jones and the battles fought in 1862 and 1863. Tours begin at 11 a.m., 1 p.m., and 3 p.m. and depart from the parking lot on Iron Brigade Unit Avenue. Please dress for the weather and wear comfortable walking shoes. Insect repellant is encouraged.
May-October: Tours on 2nd & 4th Weekends. Tours at 11 a.m., 1 p.m., and 3 p.m.; FREE
Bristoe Station Battlefield Heritage Park. The parking lot is located off Iron Brigade Unit Ave., Bristow, VA. 703-366-3049

title: Sanderson Sisters Come to Madigans!
name: Sanderson Sisters Come to Madigans!
description:
Join us Sunday, October 25th at 11:00AM for this magical brunch and show with the three Sanderson Sisters from Hocus Pocus! You and your child will get to enjoy a delicious brunch, live performances, artistic time, interactive games, dancing and photo opportunities! Event begins at 11:30. Please arrive by 11:00 to enjoy brunch.
THERE WILL BE A COSTUME CONTEST, so please come dressed if you want to participate and a chance to win some fun stuff!
All tickets are $40, babies two and under are free.
Brunch Buffet includes:
Coffee, tea, milk, or soda. Alcohol and juice are available for an additional charge.
Scrambled eggs, bacon, pancakes, roasted garlic home fries, fluffy buttermilk biscuits and sausage gravy and fresh fruit.
IMPORTANT TICKET INFO:
EVERYONE in attendance MUST have a ticket, even babies!. Children under 2 are free, but you MUST order a ticket so we can ensure a proper headcount. If you would like to sit with a group that purchased tickets separately, please let us know as soon as possible so we can ensure proper seating arrangements. All tickets purchased under the same name will automatically be seated together. You can note the names of people you wish to sit with when you make the reservation! Without a request, you will be sat randomly on our floor plan. Please also make note of any food allergies. We do our best to accommodate, but cannot guarantee cross contamination due to our communal kitchen.
This event is upstairs, and we unfortunately do not have an elevator.
